fact: The party visits Clan Ironhead as a final stop before descending into the depths.
source_quote: the party visited Clan Ironhead under the pretense of establishing their cover as dissidents against the Deepking
subject: Clan Ironhead

fact: Thangus Ironhead is the leader of Clan Ironhead.
source_quote: Thangus Ironhead, the clan's leader
subject: Thangus Ironhead

fact: Thangus Ironhead publicly dismisses the dangers of the Whorlstone Tunnels as stories to frighten children.
source_quote: Thangus Ironhead, the clan's leader, publicly dismissed the dangers of the Whorlstone Tunnels as nothing more than stories told to frighten children
subject: Thangus's dismissal

fact: Thangus claims the Whorlstone Tunnels are a place for children to play with nothing going on.
source_quote: those are but rumors for children… it's a place for children to go play. There's nothing going on.
subject: Whorlstone Tunnels

fact: Thorin responds to Thangus's dismissal by saying they will go play there.
source_quote: Thorin replied, "Okay, we'll go play there."
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin asks the clan if they know about nasty things happening in the dungeons.
source_quote: Thorin opens with: "we heard there's some nasty things going down in the dungeons. Do you know anything about that?"
subject: Thorin

fact: The clan is confused to learn the party was sent by Errde.
source_quote: The clan is pleased but confused to hear they were sent by Errde.
subject: Errde

fact: Grinta Ironhead is the granddaughter of Thangus Ironhead.
source_quote: his granddaughter Grinta Ironhead
subject: Grinta Ironhead

fact: Grinta Ironhead is referenced as the source of a clandestine political proposal.
source_quote: the party receives a clandestine political proposal from the clan leader's granddaughter.
subject: Grinta Ironhead

fact: Grinta Ironhead pulls the party aside to speak candidly as they leave.
source_quote: As the party turned to leave, his granddaughter Grinta Ironhead pulled them aside and spoke far more candidly.
subject: Grinta's intervention

fact: Grinta acknowledges that the city is a political tinderbox largely due to the Deepking's trade monopoly.
source_quote: She acknowledged that the city was a powder keg and that her clan had suffered greatly under the Deepking's trade monopoly.
subject: Deepking

fact: Grinta knows there is something going on in the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: "And I know there's something going on in the Whorlstone Caverns."
subject: Deepking

fact: Grinta proposes a deal where Clan Ironhead offers generous trade terms to those who help bring about the Deepking's departure.
source_quote: She said that if the Deepking were unseated, Clan Ironhead — which would rise to become the premier clan — would offer generous trade terms to those who had helped bring about his departure.
subject: Clan Ironhead proposal

fact: Clan Ironhead would rise to become the premier clan if the Deepking were unseated.
source_quote: Clan Ironhead — which would rise to become the premier clan — would offer generous trade terms
subject: Clan Ironhead

fact: The arrangement involves the help being indirect, effectively a discount on goods.
source_quote: The help would be "Not directly": in effect, a discount on any goods.
subject: trade discount

fact: Clan Ironhead would be free to fulfill orders advantageous to those present when the Deepking disappears.
source_quote: "Clan Ironhead would be free to do orders that were advantageous to those who happened to be around when the Deepking disappeared."
subject: favorable orders

fact: Jimjar's eyes light up upon hearing the trade proposal.
source_quote: Jimjar's eyes lit up, and he noted quietly that such an arrangement would be enormously beneficial to the people of Blingdenstone.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Jimjar notes that the deal would be highly beneficial for the people of Blingdenstone.
source_quote: such a deal would be very advantageous to the folks in Blingdenstone.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Blingdenstone is the home of the people Jimjar references.
source_quote: people of Blingdenstone
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: Thorin asks if the clan has considered staying down there to start a trade network.
source_quote: Thorin: "have you guys considered maybe we should just stay down here and start a trade network?"
subject: Thorin

fact: The party prepares to descend into the darkness of the Whorlstone Caverns.
source_quote: the party prepared to descend once more into the darkness of the Whorlstone Caverns.
subject: Whorlstone Caverns

fact: The goal for the next session is to get Werz removed from the assassins' list.
source_quote: The next session's goal is to get Werz removed from the assassins' list.
subject: Werz's removal

fact: Werz is currently on an assassins' list.
source_quote: get Werz removed from the assassins' list
subject: Werz

fact: There is an assassins' list that Werz needs to be removed from.
source_quote: get Werz removed from the assassins' list
subject: assassins

fact: The party has acquired new weapons during this visit.
source_quote: With new weapons, new allies, new secrets
subject: new weapons

fact: The party has acquired new allies and new secrets during this visit.
source_quote: new weapons, new allies, new secrets
subject: party acquisition

fact: The party has a growing web of political entanglements.
source_quote: a growing web of political entanglements
subject: political entanglements
